note: Private common IPA 719 = the content of the delivered 718 with RPCS3 Core 918 in place of Core 914 (maintainer, 10 Nov: Black Ops II and God of War III must run faster). Base: the delivered and verified 694, as for 718, because the receipt of 718 does not hold its signed image inventory (its four proof files are the API metadata and the offline verification; the recipient key was deleted after the verified delivery, as required, before the inventory was copied) and so cannot authenticate a base; every commit 718 reviewed is reviewed again with the same classification, and this build copies its inventory into its receipt. RPCS3 Core 918 replaces Core 907 of the base (Cores 908 to 914 as in 718; Core 916: the PUTLLC of an SPU on a SPURS header with relaxed reservations no longer overwrites a plain guest store, the God of War III MLAA bypass knows the installed 01.00 executable at a fresh boot, stall dump walks, compact stopped windows, the PPU region profile asked by the report; Core 917: a reservation write lock spins for 8 us before its first core hand-off, park counters, captures asked on a storm of heavy PUTLLC; Core 918: the active waits (utils::busy_wait) keep the duration they have on the 24 MHz reference counter on this device's 1 GHz counter, where they lasted 42 times less; scheduler counts per report window; with the settings on Automatic the report compares the levers between its windows, in three passes per boot). MeloNX Core 717, the host, the skins and the interface are those of 718. No iPhone measurement; no FPS claim.
